scientific_integrity: The full claim, proof, boundary cases, reproducibility script, and source comparisons are embedded. Finite exact tests only supplement an analytic argument. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Idealized independent homogeneous pairwise Poisson encounters, equal male and female counts, identical independent search-lifetime laws and unlimited male mating reuse. No field calibration or extension to correlated paths, unequal contact rates, or monogamy. Historical novelty review remains non-independent and incomplete for some older full texts.
title: A distribution-free mating-count order between male- and female-searching trap systems
